name: Ryuuka
source:
One summer day main character completes errands given by the teacher and meets a girl in a classroom that should have been empty. She calls herself Asuka and asks to find a book that is  family heirloom. She stays at her friend's house who is a shrine maiden. The three young people search for books while suspicious events like students disappearance and animals killings start to occur around them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某个夏日，主人公完成老师交代的差事后，在本应空无一人的教室里遇见了一名少女。她自称飞鸟，并请求主人公帮忙寻找一本传家之书。她借住在一名巫女朋友家中。三名年轻人开始寻找书籍，而学生失踪、动物遇害等可疑事件也在他们周围接连发生。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
